headline: Hockey Club Denies Panic After Extremely Normal Three-Game Losing Streak
dek: Team officials insist nobody has searched the standings more than fifteen times today.
excerpt: The New Zork hockey club says there is no reason for concern despite three consecutive losses and several concerning group chats.

body.text: NEW ZORK — Team officials rejected suggestions of panic Friday after the local hockey club recorded its third consecutive loss.
Coaches described the stretch as a normal part of the season and urged supporters not to draw sweeping conclusions from a small sample of games.
Nobody here is panicking. We are simply reviewing every aspect of the organization in a calm and completely ordinary manner.
Fans responded by immediately drawing sweeping conclusions from the small sample of games.
The club returns to action Saturday in a game that analysts described as both meaningless in the long term and absolutely essential in the next twenty-four hours.
